scientific_role: new independently selected real-system validation after transport-qualified source screening

source_identity.acquisition_route: GitHub blob fetch at frozen commit; response and covariate files are individually addressable

prelock_transport_qualification.rationale: source files are individually addressable Git blobs; candidate registry/covariates do not require opening an archive containing unrelated response payloads

endpoint.focal_taxon_selection_basis: the public tutorial dataset itself is explicitly a single-species Chicago raccoon occupancy teaching dataset; no species choice is made from prevalence ranking
endpoint.candidate_site_definition: exact Site identifier in the frozen raccoon table
endpoint.zero_interpretation: survey-day non-detection at a camera site, not biological absence

prospective_gates.gate0: verify frozen source blobs and parse only non-Day columns plus covariate table; build coordinate/site registry and candidate-day effort universe without opening Day_1..Day_31 values
prospective_gates.gate1: compile response-independent v2 manifest, structural worlds, candidate preflight and prediction-state eligibility
prospective_gates.response_gate: only if Gate0/Gate1 pass, freeze exact response parser/count thresholds/evaluation before opening any Day_* token

predictive_design.outer_unit: prospectively generated spatial fold from coordinates only; no response-stratified reassignment
predictive_design.train_serve_generator_policy: same sequential preoutcome generator contract for calibration cross-fit and heldout serving
